chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to me, saying: Al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Samad narrated to me, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Uthman, from 'Ibad ibn Abd al-Khaliq, from one who narrated to him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, for Allah, the Exalted, there are twelve thousand worlds; each of them is greater than the seven heavens and the seven earths. You do not see any one of them except that for Allah, the Exalted, there is another world besides it. And I am the proof (Hujjah) for them.
ai.seo_question: How many worlds did God create according to Imam al-Sadiq, and what is the role of the Imam in them?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) description of the *Kathrat al-Aalam* (multiplicity of worlds), where twelve thousand realms exist, each surpassing the known seven heavens and earths in magnitude. This cosmology underscores the infinite scope of Divine knowledge, with each world possessing its own distinct reality, while the Imam serves as the universal *Hujjah* (divine proof) and guide for all these creations.
